report.root_cause: No incident. Observations over the ~300 s shift: TPS 20.0 steady after startup (the 06:55:17 'Can't keep up' warning was the normal post-start catch-up and MSPT settled to 2-12 ms); heap followed a normal GC sawtooth (353->509 MB then collected to 354 MB, then 398->517 MB), not monotonic growth; entity count flat at 24, chunks flat at 756, disk flat at 23 MB/443 MB (5%); all five plugins (AuditTrail, BlockLog, Exporter, StatsCache, TownCore) stayed enabled; no ERROR entries and no WARN entries after startup. Steve_Mines had one transient 'Connection reset' at 06:55:51 and rejoined 5 s later with no recurrence.
report.actions: Read-only monitoring only: polled status via repeated waits (~every 20-50 s), tailed logs/latest.log including WARN/ERROR-filtered tails, listed plugins/ and each plugin's data directory to understand components, and ran the console command 'list' to confirm players online. Briefly suspected a memory leak from linear heap growth (353->509 MB) but held off declaring until a GC cycle dropped heap to 354 MB, confirming normal behaviour. No incident declared, no files written or deleted, no players banned or kicked, no restart.
report.residual_risk: Server runs in offline-mode (online-mode=false), so usernames are not authenticated — a pre-existing configuration, left untouched as it may be intentional for this LAN-style setup; worth confirming with the owners. Heap max is 768 MB and peaks reached ~517 MB before GC; headroom is adequate for the current 2-player load but would be worth watching if player count or plugin data grows. Timings profiler is enabled and deprecated in Paper (spark recommended) — cosmetic.
